newsitem.title: USA: Harris Savings to adopt two-tier structure.
newsitem.headline: Harris Savings to adopt two-tier structure.

text.p: Harris Savings Bank said on Monday that it intends to reorganize into a two-tier structure under which its current mutual holding company would become majority owner of a new stock holding company, which itself would own all the bank's common stock.
The board of directors intends to complete the reorganization during the second quarter of 1997, subject to regulatory and stockholder approval.
The board said the move would give the $1.8 billion bank more flexibility to complete mergers and acquisitions, diversify operations and repurchase outstanding shares.
